name: Don N. Holt Bridge
facts: Don N. Holt Bridge, completed in 1992, is a three‑span continuous modified Warren truss that carries I‑526 across the Cooper River, linking Charleston with North Charleston.
Designed by HNTB Corporation, the bridge’s deck sits at the same height as nearby smokestacks, prompting a lawsuit that led to the first road weather information system in a U.S. highway bridge.
The RWIS, installed in 1992, uses variable‑message signs and runway‑style pavement lights to warn drivers of dense fog, and by May 2003, no fog‑related crashes had occurred on the span.
